conversations
  Add a [[conversation]] route to dreamcatcher.toml and restart the daemon to enable conversations.

campaigns
  Add a [[campaign]] route to dreamcatcher.toml and restart the daemon to enable campaigns.         
  Configure a campaign route:                                                                       
  https://alimanfoo.github.io/dreamcatcher/start-a-campaign/#configure-a-campaign-route
